summary: GP-Act III Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its sponsor and three independent directors voluntarily converted all 7,187,500 Class B ordinary shares (founder shares) into Class A ordinary shares on a one-for-one basis. No consideration changed hands; the conversion was done in accordance with the company's charter. Terms of the original letter agreement—voting, transfer restrictions, trust waiver—continue to apply. The conversion eliminated all Class B shares, leaving ~35.9 million Class A shares outstanding, with no impact on voting power. This is an internal share reclassification, not a special situation. There is no deal, premium, or strategic event to watch.
